summary: Comprehensive backend testing of Ozoxx Experience MVP completed. 41/41 pytest tests passed covering: public config, JWT auth (login/register/me), admin appearance/event/tickets/users/integrations/stats CRUD, order creation (guest + companion), simulate-pay credential generation, retry, scanner role-gated validate + already-checked-in flow, /api/me/credentials with QR base64, public credential lookup, and RBAC (non-admin -> 403). PagBank gracefully returns success=false when keys empty (200 not 500). Resend gracefully returns 'API key não configurada' when empty. Retry against unconfigured PagBank correctly returns 502.

minor.issue: Backend silently lowercases the email on store but uses EmailStr that accepts mixed case — this is acceptable behavior but tests had to compare against lowercase. Not a bug, just behavior to document.

Guest order is created BEFORE PagBank integration is attempted; if PagBank fails (e.g., empty creds), an orphan WAITING order remains in DB. Consider deleting/marking failed when payment_ready=false, or returning 400 instead of a 200 with payment_error. Currently returns 200 with payment_ready=false which is a UX trade-off.
Dev helper has NO auth — anyone can mark any order PAID. Acceptable for MVP/dev but should be gated by env flag or admin role before production.
Both unauthenticated — leak order info (including holder PII) by order_id. Consider scoping to owner or admin/financeiro.
Excludes email but returns full credential incl. holder name, ticket name, checked_in status — that's by design as a public lookup, but make sure code is unguessable (12 hex chars looks fine).

action_items: (optional) Auth-gate /api/orders/{id}/simulate-pay behind an ENV flag (e.g., ENABLE_DEV_SIMULATE_PAY=true) or admin role before production.
(optional) Restrict GET /api/orders/{id} and /refresh-status to the owning user / admin / financeiro to avoid leaking PII by order_id enumeration.

(optional) When PagBank fails on POST /api/orders, decide whether to (a) delete the orphan order, (b) return 502 instead of 200 with payment_error, or (c) document the current behavior — current behavior is 200 with payment_ready=false.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers will still reject this for cookie-bearing requests from cross-origin in some setups. The Bearer header path works fine and was used by these tests, so functionally OK, but if cookie-based auth is required in prod, set explicit FRONTEND_URL list.
Cookies are set with secure=True samesite='none' — fine for HTTPS preview but will fail on plain HTTP local dev.
auth.py seed_admin updates password if it changes — good idempotent behavior matching the playbook.
bcrypt hashes start with $2b$ (verified via login flow) — playbook compliance OK.
orders_routes.create_order_endpoint does a manual try/except get_current_user — fine pattern for guest+auth mixed endpoints.
simulate-pay endpoint is wide-open; flag this before prod.
scanner_routes.validate_credential correctly: 1) rejects empty code 2) returns valid=false (200) for not_found / unpaid / already_checked_in 3) marks checked_in atomically. Good UX.
/api/me/credentials joins by user_id OR email — handles guest-then-registered flow well.
models.py: OrderCreate's companion is Optional but validation done in route — could use Pydantic root_validator for cleaner errors.
test_credentials: admin@ozoxx.com / OzoxxAdmin@2025 (admin role) — works as documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md
seed_data_creation: Tests create transient ticket types (test_*), users (test_user_*, test_cred_*), orders (test_guest/test_retry/companion). A best-effort module-scope cleanup fixture deletes test_-prefixed users. Orders/credentials/tickets created during tests are intentionally NOT cleaned up since they're useful as seed for further frontend testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully functional and ready for frontend integration testing. PagBank and Resend are intentionally unconfigured — admin can configure them via PUT /api/admin/integrations to enable real payment + email. simulate-pay dev helper is available for end-to-end credential generation without real payment. Bearer token auth via Authorization header works reliably across all role-gated endpoints. Note: tests create a paid order with companion tied to a participant user (by email) so /api/me/credentials returns 2 credentials including QR base64.
rca of the issue: N/A — no production bugs found. Only initial test failures were due to test asserting against the originally-cased email while backend lowercases on store; fixed by using lowercase test_ prefix in test data.
